description_en: Queries whether the current Alibaba Cloud account has purchased a MetaAgent trial package
description_zh: 查询当前主账号是否购买过MetaAgent体验包
name: GetMetaAgentTrialPurchaseStatus

Data.description_en: The historical purchase status of the trial package for the current Alibaba Cloud account, including expired and suspended records. This does not indicate that the current benefits are valid
Data.description_zh: 当前主账号的体验包历史购买状态，包含已到期和已停服记录，不代表当前权益有效

HasPurchasedTrialPackage.description_en: Indicates whether a trial package has been purchased, including expired and suspended records
HasPurchasedTrialPackage.description_zh: 是否购买过体验包（包含已到期和已停服记录）
HasPurchasedTrialPackage.title_en: 是否购买过体验包（包含已到期和已停服记录）
HasPurchasedTrialPackage.title_zh: 是否购买过体验包（包含已到期和已停服记录）

ShouldShowInventoryReminder.description_en: Indicates whether to remind associated instances to perform asset inventory. The value is true if a trial package has been purchased and the current tenant has no instances with successful inventory
ShouldShowInventoryReminder.description_zh: 是否提醒关联实例进行资产盘点；购买过体验包且当前租户没有成功盘点的实例时为true
ShouldShowInventoryReminder.title_en: 是否提醒关联实例进行资产盘点；购买过体验包且当前租户没有成功盘点的实例时为true。
ShouldShowInventoryReminder.title_zh: 是否提醒关联实例进行资产盘点；购买过体验包且当前租户没有成功盘点的实例时为true。

Data.title_en: 当前主账号的体验包历史购买状态，包含已到期和已停服记录，不代表当前权益有效。
Data.title_zh: 当前主账号的体验包历史购买状态，包含已到期和已停服记录，不代表当前权益有效。

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
